title: chromolaena galeana
intro: Chromolaena galeana, commonly known as Mexican mint marigold, is a medicinal plant species within the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Chromolaena galeana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and immune-modulating activities. The plant's bioactive constituents, particularly sesquiterpene lactones, have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties.
